acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mass spectrometry techniques were used for MS scanning and tandem MS data acquisition.
collision energy: selected for fragmentation by higher-energy collision dissociation with a normalized collision energy of 28.
enrichment method: ChIRP-MS was performed to directly explore the proteins bound to BTBD7_hsa_circ_0000563.
fragmentation method: selected for fragmentation by higher-energy collision dissociation with a normalized collision energy of 28.
instrument: The tandem MS data were acquired on a ThermoFisher Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher, USA)
ionization type: fitted with a Nano Flex ion source
labeling: The MS/MS data were analysed for the identification and quantification of proteins bound to BTBD7_hsa_circ_0000563 using PEAKS Studio 10.6.
precursor tolerance: The precursor and fragment mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.05 Da, respectively.
fragment tolerance: The precursor and fragment mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.05 Da, respectively.
ptm: oxidation (M) (variable); acetylation (protein N-term) (variable); deamidation (NQ) (variable); pyro-glu from E (variable); pyro-glu from Q (variable); carbamidomethylation of cysteine (fixed)
The settings of oxidation (M), acetylation (protein N-term), deamidation (NQ), pyro-glu from E, pyro-glu from Q for variable modifications and fixed carbamidomethylation of cysteine were selected.
